parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the methods `stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78), they are distinct test cases verifying different observable post-stop behaviours — idle-state transition versus the `isPlaying` flag — and their near-duplication is an expected consequence of the arrange-act-assert pattern common in unit tests. Collapsing them would obscure the individual failure signal each test is designed to surface.
